CHAPTER.VERS: Blessed every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.
For thou shalt eat the labour of thy hands: happy thou , and well with thee.
Thy wife as a fruitful vine by the sides of thy house: thy children like olive plants around thy table.
Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD.
The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
Yea, thou shalt see thy children’s children, peace upon Israel.
